raw.text:
As an archivist, my methodology requires me to assess the immediate threats to our existing "collection"—which, in this context, means human lives and community infrastructure. While long-term pandemic-preparedness research is a vital investment in future stability, an active flood poses an immediate, catastrophic, and ongoing threat to the present. Methodical preservation dictates that we must first stabilize and secure our current foundation before we can meaningfully invest in long-term future scenarios. 

Therefore, I am directing the grant to address the active crisis.
